clue.text: Go ahead and refuse

parts.note: to pass is to go by or proceed
being up means being ahead, as in one up in a game

explanation.surface: Someone is told to proceed and still says no.
explanation.definitionFit: To pass up an offer is to decline or turn it down.

clue.text: A paper under discussion

parts.note: tissue is a thin soft paper

explanation.surface: A newspaper being debated at a meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: A matter at issue is the point currently being debated.

clue.text: Caught infiltrating lay religious group

indicators.note: infiltrating means getting inside, so the cricket letter goes into the synonym for lay

parts.note: to lay something down is to set it
C is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: Someone is caught working their way into a lay religious movement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lay' looks like the adjective (not clergy) but is the verb, put or place.
explanation.definitionFit: A sect is a breakaway body of worshippers sharing distinct beliefs.

clue.text: Pressure on a couple twisting people

parts.note: P is the standard abbreviation for pressure in physics

indicators.note: twisting tells us the letters of the words a couple are wrenched into a new order

explanation.surface: Two people are being pressured into contorting themselves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'twisting' rearranges A COUPLE into OPULACE, placed after P ('on' joins them, P coming first in a down entry).
explanation.definitionFit: The populace is the general public, the ordinary inhabitants of a place.

clue.text: Accountant to check about a warning

parts.note: CA stands for chartered accountant

indicators.note: about here means going round, so the check word surrounds the letter A

parts.note: to vet something is to check it over

explanation.surface: An accountant is told to look over some sort of caution.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' wraps the check word round the clue's 'a'; the accountant piece comes first.
explanation.definitionFit: A caveat is a cautionary proviso or notice to beware.

clue.text: Attribute soldiers breaking record to it

indicators.note: breaking means splitting open, so the soldiers split the record's letters

parts.note: CD, a compact disc, is a kind of record
RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
taken as written

explanation.surface: Soldiers smashing a record get the blame for it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Attribute' is a verb here, not a noun; 'breaking' puts the soldiers inside the record, and 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To credit something to someone is to ascribe it to them as its source.

clue.text: Give a list out that's incomplete

indicators.note: out signals the words give a list are put out of their order, rearranged

explanation.surface: An instruction to hand out a list that is not finished.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges GIVE A LIST into the answer; 'that's' links the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A vestigial organ is a remnant, rudimentary and not fully developed.

clue.text: About to go over precis

parts.note: a. is an abbreviation for about, meaning approximately
to bridge a gap is to span it, to go over it

explanation.surface: Someone is about to look over a summary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'precis' is a verb here: to summarise.
explanation.definitionFit: To abridge a text is to shorten it, just as one does when writing a summary.

clue.text: Rule that's paramount, we hear

indicators.note: we hear tells us the word for paramount is only said, giving a different spelling of the same sound

parts.note: principal means chief or paramount

explanation.surface: A ruling of the highest importance, according to report.
explanation.definitionFit: A principle is a fundamental law or tenet that governs conduct.

clue.text: View one has to take against European future

parts.note: a prospect is a view or vista
I is the Roman numeral for one
V, short for versus, means against

explanation.surface: An opinion that someone must hold in opposition to a European future.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has to take' just links the pieces in order.
explanation.definitionFit: A prospective buyer is a would-be one, someone expected in time to come.

clue.text: Imperative to clear out?

parts.note: an imperative is a command form of a verb, so this is a one-word order telling someone to get out fast

explanation.surface: A pressing need to tidy up a room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Imperative' looks like an adjective meaning urgent; it is the grammatical mood of a command.
explanation.definitionFit: This slangy command means go away at once, an order to leave.

clue.text: Lose the chance to be a smith working with silver primarily

indicators.note: working means the letters of to be a smith are worked into a new shape
primarily picks the first letter of silver

explanation.surface: Someone forgoes the chance of becoming a silversmith.
explanation.walkthrough: 'working with silver primarily' rearranges TO BE A SMITH together with S, the first letter of 'silver'.
explanation.definitionFit: To miss the boat is an idiom for failing to take an opportunity in time.

clue.text: River feeding into dangerous estuary

indicators.note: feeding into suggests a river flowing inside, so the answer sits across the words dangerous estuary

explanation.surface: A river that runs into a perilous estuary.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sits across 'dangerOUS Estuary'. The Ouse is a river in Yorkshire, England, which does feed the Humber estuary.
explanation.definitionFit: The Ouse is one of several English rivers bearing that name.

clue.text: Athenian's basic ideal getting distorted

definitions.note: the 's stands for is, so the definition reads Athenian is

indicators.note: getting distorted says the letters of basic ideal are bent into a new order

explanation.surface: A Greek's fundamental principle being twisted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting distorted' rearranges BASIC IDEAL. Alcibiades was a general and politician of ancient Athens.
explanation.definitionFit: Alcibiades was a statesman of classical Athens and a pupil of Socrates.

clue.text: Lie about time coppers will come round

indicators.note: come round means surround, so the coin word goes round the other two pieces

parts.note: copper coins are pennies, so coppers gives pence
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: Lying about the time the police will arrive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coppers' looks like police; it is copper coins, which 'will come round' the other two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A pretence is a false show, a deception meant to mislead.

clue.text: One who's not full of himself?

definitions.text: One who's not full of himself?

parts.words: One who's not full of himself?
parts.note: not a modest person but one whose own body is not full: a lean, slightly built body type

explanation.surface: Someone who is modest rather than conceited.
explanation.walkthrough: 'full of himself' means conceited, but here it is literal: the person's physique is not filled out.
explanation.definitionFit: An ectomorph is a person with a thin, lightly muscled build.

clue.text: Lacking skill in English exercise

parts.note: taken as written
PT is physical training, exercise

explanation.surface: Someone shows poor ability in an English assignment.
explanation.definitionFit: An inept person is clumsy and incompetent.

clue.text: Reduce by agreement

explanation.surface: Cutting something down through mutual consent.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to shrink (a verb) and a legal deal (a noun).

clue.text: Resistance eliminated in hidden desire

indicators.note: eliminated means taken away, so the resistance letter is removed

parts.note: covert means hidden or secret
R is the physics symbol for resistance

explanation.surface: A secret longing with the opposition crushed.
explanation.definitionFit: To covet is to long for something, especially another's possession.

clue.text: Type of condiment from Virgin Islands, new range

indicators.note: new signals that the letters are made into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A seasoning sourced from a Caribbean territory's latest product line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges VI with RANGE.
explanation.definitionFit: Vinegar is a sour liquid used to season or preserve food, a common table relish.

clue.text: Everyone comes back through wood in the fall

indicators.note: through means passing inside, so the reversed piece goes inside the wood

parts.note: a copse is a small wood

indicators.note: comes back means the word for everyone is turned to read backwards

parts.note: all means everyone

explanation.surface: Everyone returns through the woods in autumn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fall' looks like the American autumn, matching the wood; it means a collapse. 'comes back' turns ALL to LLA, which goes 'through' COPSE.
explanation.definitionFit: A collapse is a sudden falling down or caving in.

clue.text: Venture to provide forecast

definitions.meaning: to estimate or predict from present figures

explanation.surface: A business scheme meant to supply a prediction.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a planned undertaking and a verb meaning to extrapolate.

clue.text: Secure monarch decapitated in revolution

indicators.note: in revolution suggests turmoil, so the remaining letters are rearranged
decapitated means the head, the first letter, of monarch is cut off

explanation.surface: A king beheaded during an uprising is made safe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'decapitated' leaves ONARCH, which 'in revolution' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: To anchor something is to fix it firmly in place.

clue.text: A mention in translation, without a name

indicators.note: translation means turning into another form, so the letters of a mention in are rearranged

explanation.surface: A passing reference that, once translated, loses its name.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'in' of 'in translation' is fodder: rearrange A MENTION IN.
explanation.definitionFit: Innominate means unnamed or anonymous.

clue.text: Old bird you've to cook twice

indicators.note: twice means the word for cook is written two times over

parts.note: to do meat is to cook it

explanation.surface: An ancient fowl that must be cooked two times.
explanation.walkthrough: The dodo was a flightless bird, extinct since the 17th century.
explanation.definitionFit: The dodo was a flightless bird of Mauritius, long extinct.

clue.text: What may be caused by a rash impulse

definitions.text: What may be caused by a rash
definitions.meaning: a skin eruption produces a tingling urge to scratch

explanation.surface: An impetuous urge leads to a hasty result.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rash' looks like an adjective meaning hasty; it is a skin eruption.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both the irritation that makes one scratch and a restless longing.

clue.text: Storm over accepting Latin composer

indicators.note: accepting means taking in, so the reversed word holds the Latin letter
over in a across clue means turned over, read backwards

parts.note: to rage is to storm

explanation.surface: A tantrum over admitting a Latin composer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' turns RAGE into EGAR, 'accepting' puts L inside. Edward Elgar was an English composer.
explanation.definitionFit: Edward Elgar wrote the Enigma Variations and Pomp and Circumstance marches.

clue.text: Sort of emotion upset father let out

indicators.note: upset means knocked over, so the letters of father let are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Feelings when an upset father lets them out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' rearranges FATHER LET; 'out' completes the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A heartfelt feeling is sincere, felt deeply.

clue.text: He may shoot demonstrator heading off

indicators.note: heading off means the first letter is removed

parts.note: a marcher is a protester on a demonstration

explanation.surface: Someone could open fire on a protester once he leaves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'demonstrator' looks like someone showing a product; it is a protester.
explanation.definitionFit: An archer shoots arrows from a bow.

clue.text: Time a strike before one reaches island

parts.note: to hit is to strike
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A timed strike before someone arrives at an island.
explanation.definitionFit: Tahiti is the largest island of French Polynesia in the South Pacific.
